summary: Backend-only testing of the bug fix for PATCH /api/users/{user_id}/compensation role authorization. The fix extends accepted roles to include ATHLETE (in addition to COACH/DIRIGENTE/VIEWER/COLLABORATORE) and enriches error message with the current role. All 8 tests passed (8/8 = 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L4956-L5036: endpoint logic is sound. Note that for role=athlete the canonical monthly_compensation lives on db.athletes (athlete_type=compensated) while this endpoint writes only to db.users — the sync the other way is handled elsewhere (iteration_74). Confirm UI reads from the right collection for PRO athletes to avoid display drift.

server.py L4992 / L5002: bare `except:` swallows date parsing errors silently — invalid contract dates produce a 200 with no DB update and no feedback. Recommend narrowing to ValueError/TypeError and returning HTTP 400 with field name.

Error message currently says 'coach, dirigenti, collaboratori e atleti PRO' but allowed list still includes VIEWER — copy is slightly misleading for viewer rejections (none observed in tests, but worth aligning).

Athlete PRO compensation lives on both db.users (this endpoint) and db.athletes (synced elsewhere — see iteration_74).

rca of the issue: Original bug: VERDI FABIO (target user) had role='athlete' in db.users even though the admin UI rendered him under 'dirigenti'. The endpoint guard at server.py L4966 allowed only [COACH, DIRIGENTE, VIEWER, COLLABORATORE] so it returned 400 'Compenso applicabile solo a coach, dirigenti e collaboratori'. Fix: added ATHLETE to the allow-list and included role in the error message so future role-mismatches are diagnosable. Reproduction and remediation are both verified by the new pytest suite.
